usage: verify_gate.py [-h] --gate {0,3,8,rc,gate0,gate3,gate8,gaterc} [--dir DIR] [--project PROJECT] [--run RUN] [--accept-open-bugs REASON]

Verify gate compliance for dev-cycle-protocol

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --gate {0,3,8,rc,gate0,gate3,gate8,gaterc}
                        Gate to verify (0=product baseline, 3=plan approval, rc=candidate acceptance, 8=release readiness)
  --dir DIR             Workspace directory
  --project PROJECT     Project name override
  --run RUN             Release candidate run label, for example v1.4.0-rc.1
  --accept-open-bugs REASON
                        Gate 3: the user explicitly accepts approving a non-bug plan with open blocking bugs
